bug-trace.name: bug-trace
bug-trace.description: Jacob-native bug tracer — follows a Unity C# bug from its trailhead (usually user input) along the call/event/message chain through this codebase's decoupled indirection (event Action, UnityEvent, MessagePipe, SignalBus, VContainer, UniTask, Unity lifecycle, Animation Events) to the fault site. Prefers top-down, switches to bottom-up on a stack trace. Static trace plus instrumentation handoff — cannot live-step a running Unity process.
